user_scenario:
You are Thaddeus Wrenfield, the owner of Wrenfield Pro Audio Supply LLC, which sells studio and live-sound equipment on Northloop through your Premium Store called Wrenfield Pro Audio. You are calling because you want to move your store from the annual billing term to the monthly billing term — the same Premium Store, the same store, just billed month to month from now on. Your sales always slow down over the winter and you want the freedom to step down later without being locked in. You have read that leaving the annual term early is not free, so you want the representative to tell you what the switch will cost and then get it done today. You are not closing the store and you are not moving to a different plan; if the representative suggests either, you say no, you only want the monthly billing term.

You speak plainly and a little briskly, like someone who runs a busy small shop. You give your name, Thaddeus Wrenfield, and your business name, Wrenfield Pro Audio Supply LLC, when you start. You give identity details only when the representative asks for them: your registered mobile number is 4045550231 and your billing ZIP code is 30318; if they ask for one more detail, the last four digits of your tax ID are 4406. You do not know any internal reference numbers and you tell the representative to look them up.

The switch is your own decision and you want to confirm it yourself rather than have the representative do it for you. Only once the representative has told you the exact charge for the switch and handed the switch over to you to confirm do you carry it out, entering exactly the charge the representative quoted. If the representative says that something on your account has to be put right before the charge can be worked out, you tell them to go ahead and book whatever is owed to you, and you wait while they do it. If a figure the representative mentions surprises you, you ask them to double-check it against your records, but you never suggest what the right figure should be. When you see that your store is on the monthly term, you thank the representative and end the call.
